question: In the morning, a warehouse had 191 boxes of canned soup on the loading dock. By midday, a delivery added 15 more boxes. In the afternoon, 123 boxes were shipped out to a grocery chain. That evening, a supply drive turned every remaining box into 4 boxes. Right before closing, 56 more boxes arrived from a late shipment. How many boxes of canned soup were on the loading dock after the late shipment?

In the morning, a shoe factory had 222 pairs of sneakers ready to ship. By midday, 131 pairs were sent to a retail chain, and in the afternoon a return shipment brought back 72 pairs due to a sizing error. The shipping manager mentioned a dozen extra shoeboxes had also arrived, though that had nothing to do with the pair count. That evening, a rush order turned every pair into 8 pairs. Right after, 70 more pairs arrived from the factory floor, and before the night shift ended, 78 more pairs were finished. A final bulk order turned every pair into 8 pairs. How many pairs of sneakers were there after the final bulk order?

Fatima had 208 stickers in her sticker book, while her friend Layla had 150 stickers in hers. Fatima found 8 more stickers in her backpack, and a friend gave her 79 more as a gift. Fatima's mom mentioned a dozen new sticker sheets were on sale, though she didn't buy any yet, so it didn't affect the total. She then earned 26 more stickers from a reading challenge. A sticker-trading event turned every sticker into 5 stickers, and a final trade turned every sticker into 7 stickers. How many stickers did Fatima have after the final trade?

In the morning, Ethan had $18 saved from his chores. By midday, he earned $33 more from raking leaves, and in the afternoon he earned $6 more from returning bottles. His neighbor mentioned that 15 bags of leaves were also raked that week, but that had nothing to do with his savings. That evening, he earned $73 more from a weekend job, and right after, a birthday bonus turned every dollar he had into 6 dollars. Before bed, he earned $38 more from selling old toys, and the next morning he found $63 more in a forgotten envelope. How much money did Ethan have after finding the money in the envelope?

Hana had 134 origami cranes folded for a school display, while her classmate Ren had 90 cranes of his own. Hana gave away 133 cranes to decorate the gym for a big event. Her remaining cranes then tripled when her art teacher assigned a matching project. A folding marathon turned every crane into 7 cranes. A final showcase turned every crane into 7 more cranes. How many cranes did Hana have for the display after the final showcase?

A community garden had 125 tomatoes ready to pick at the start of the week. A volunteer picked 68 more tomatoes the next day. The garden coordinator mentioned a dozen new watering cans had also arrived, though that had nothing to do with the tomato count. Another volunteer picked 38 more tomatoes, and a third added 59 more to the harvest bin. A fourth picked 34 more, all within a stretch the coordinator described as '120 minutes, or two hours' of picking. At the end of the week, 196 tomatoes were donated to a local food pantry. How many tomatoes were left after the donation?

A greenhouse had 180 tomato seedlings ready in early spring. The seedling count doubled when a second greenhouse batch was combined in. A wholesale nursery order then turned every seedling into 7 seedlings. A shipping error caused 2278 seedlings to be lost in transit. A final matching order turned every remaining seedling into 5 seedlings. How many seedlings were there after the final matching order?

In the morning, a print shop had 107 banners ready for a city festival. By midday, a bulk order turned every banner into 4 banners, and in the afternoon a local business added 75 more. The print shop manager mentioned a dozen extra grommets were also included, though that had nothing to do with the banner count. That evening, a rush order turned every banner into 9 banners, and right after, 26 more banners were added from a walk-in customer. Before the festival began, a final bulk order turned every banner into 8 banners. How many banners were there when the festival began?

In the morning, a school had 210 books donated for the book fair. By midday, the donation count tripled when a local publisher matched the drive. In the afternoon, a parent group added 55 more books. That evening, a second school donated 75 more books. Right before the fair opened, a final donor added 71 more books. How many books were there when the fair opened?

A vineyard had 92 crates of grapes ready at the start of harvest. A bumper crop turned every crate into 4 crates, and a second bumper crop turned each of those into 9 crates. The vineyard manager mentioned a dozen new crates were also purchased for storage, though that had nothing to do with the grape count. A regional co-op then added 75 more crates. A final harvest surge turned every crate into 7 crates, a rush that took '420 minutes, or seven hours' to bring in. A large wine producer then bought 1124 crates in one order. How many crates of grapes were left after the wine producer's order?

Wesley had 219 hockey cards in a shoebox, while his teammate Drew had 140 cards in his own box. A trading event turned every card Wesley had into 6 cards, and he then split his cards evenly among 6 friends and kept only his own original share. He then split what remained evenly into 3 binders and kept just one binder. He traded away 44 cards from that binder at a card show, and then lost 21 more that got left behind at practice. Finally, he found 65 more cards in an old backpack. How many cards did Wesley have after finding the cards in the backpack?

Kira had 122 friendship bracelets in a box, while her friend Nova had 80 bracelets in hers. Kira gave away 19 bracelets to classmates, then made 61 more over the weekend, a project that took '120 minutes, or two hours' to finish. She then donated 141 bracelets to a school fundraiser. Kira's mom mentioned a dozen new beads were also bought for future projects, though that had nothing to do with the bracelet count. She gave away 20 more bracelets to her cousins. Finally, a craft fair prize turned every bracelet into 5 bracelets. How many bracelets did Kira have after the craft fair prize?

Beckett had 61 toy soldiers set up on his shelf, while his brother Cole had 35 soldiers of his own. Beckett gave away 42 soldiers to a younger neighbor. A toy swap then turned every remaining soldier into 2 soldiers. He then lost 26 soldiers that got packed away by mistake during a move. Finally, he gave 6 more to a cousin visiting for the weekend. How many toy soldiers did Beckett have left after giving some to his cousin?

Marisol had 60 dollars saved for a new phone case, while her friend Yuki had 90 dollars saved for headphones. Marisol earned 46 more dollars from dog walking. She then earned 41 more from a bake sale. A birthday gift added 53 more dollars, arriving in a card that took '60 minutes, or one hour' to open at the party. A matching bonus from her uncle turned every dollar she had into 4 dollars. Finally, she spent 556 dollars on a new laptop for school. How much money did Marisol have left after buying the laptop?

Delilah had 229 origami stars in a jar for a wedding decoration project, while her friend Priya had 150 stars in her own jar. Delilah used 184 stars to decorate the reception hall archway. She then gave 37 more stars to the wedding planner for table settings. A crafting class then turned every remaining star into 6 stars. Finally, she used 35 stars for the guest book table. How many origami stars did Delilah have left after decorating the guest book table?

A shipping company had 117 crates of tools ready for delivery. A bulk restock turned every crate into 8 crates. The crates were then split evenly between 2 trucks, and only one truck's load was tracked. A large order then took 259 crates from that truck's load. A final restock turned every remaining crate into 3 crates. How many crates were on that truck after the final restock?

A toy store had 48 remote-control cars in stock at the start of the month. A new shipment added 25 more cars. A bulk promotion then turned every car into 6 cars. The cars were then split evenly among 6 store branches, and only the flagship branch's stock was tracked. A final donation added 73 more cars to that branch. How many remote-control cars were at the flagship branch after the donation?

A national charity had 154 blankets collected in the first week of a winter drive. A matching corporate sponsor turned every blanket into 9 blankets. A second matching sponsor turned each of those into 9 blankets, a process that took '600 minutes, or ten hours' to log and confirm. A local group then added 16 more blankets. A massive shipment of 10893 blankets was sent out to a disaster relief effort in another region. A final small donation added 6 more blankets. How many blankets did the charity have after the final donation?

Owen had 85 die-cast cars in his collection, while his cousin Blake had 200 cars in his own display. Owen's collection grew by 48 more cars when his uncle passed down an old set. His total then doubled when a toy convention offered a matching trade. A dealer's bulk trade turned every car into 6 cars. A final rare trade turned every car into 4 cars. Afterward, he sold 5839 cars to a collector's warehouse to fund a new hobby. How many die-cast cars did Owen have left after that sale?

A movie prop warehouse had 141 replica shields ready for a film shoot. The set designer mentioned that 20 extra swords had also been ordered, though that had nothing to do with the shield count. During filming, 119 shields were damaged in a stunt scene and set aside. A repair crew then turned every remaining shield into 2 shields using spare parts. The shields were then split evenly into 4 storage crates, and only one crate's contents were tracked for the next scene. A final prop delivery turned every shield in that crate into 6 shields. How many shields were in that crate after the final delivery?

In the morning, a bakery had 179 bagels ready for the day. By midday, a fresh batch added 72 more bagels. The baker mentioned a dozen new bagel trays had also arrived, though that had nothing to do with the bagel count. In the afternoon, 215 bagels were sold during the lunch rush. That evening, a catering order turned every remaining bagel into 5 bagels. Right before closing, the bagels were split evenly into 3 delivery boxes, and only one box was sent to the final customer. How many bagels were in that box?

Naomi had 196 seashells in her collection, while her friend Ling had 100 shells in hers. A shell-multiplying trade turned every shell Naomi had into 8 shells. She then found 27 more shells while beachcombing. A second trade turned every shell into 9 shells. Finally, she found 27 more shells during a low tide. How many shells did Naomi have after finding the shells during low tide?

A charity 10K raised $75 from early sign-ups. A local business then donated $38 more. A runner added $5 by rounding up their fee. The race director mentioned a dozen volunteers had helped that morning, a setup that took '90 minutes, or an hour and a half.' A sponsor then required paying out $101 in prize money. A matching grant turned every dollar raised into 9 dollars. Finally, a last-minute donor added $80 more. How much money did the charity 10K raise after the last-minute donation?

A print shop had 189 posters ready for a music festival. A bulk order turned every poster into 5 posters, but a printing error ruined 193 posters, which had to be discarded. The shop manager mentioned that 25 extra ink cartridges were also ordered, though that had nothing to do with the poster count. A second bulk order then turned every remaining poster into 7 posters, a run that took '240 minutes, or four hours' to finish. Right after, 16 more posters were added from a test print. A final festival sponsor order turned every poster into 4 posters. How many posters were there after the final sponsor order?

Kenji had 66 vinyl records in his collection, while his friend Ada had 40 records in hers. Kenji sold 38 records at a record fair. His uncle mentioned a dozen record sleeves had also been given away, though that had nothing to do with the record count. He then received 78 more records from an estate sale. A rare vinyl trade turned every record into 8 records, and a second trade turned each of those into 9 records. A final trade turned every record into 9 more records. How many records did Kenji have after the final trade?
